title: 第30章上智破联军雪崩封堵追兵第29章下三方合围星点一剑破结丹
slug: 欠我时间债天道也得跪着还
lines: 对峙没有持续太久。
烈阳宗的领头修士是一个筑基后期的壮汉，身穿赤红战甲，战甲上刻满了火焰纹路，手持一柄燃烧着烈焰的鬼头大刀。
他在北邙混了二十年，从未在同辈面前吃过瘪。
今天被一个十几岁的少年当着一众同门的面撂下狠话，若不找回场子，以后在烈阳宗也不用混了。
他暴喝一声，鬼头大刀上的烈焰骤然暴涨至三丈高，刀罡裹挟着灼热到扭曲空气的高温朝最前方那尊持剑战傀劈去。
“区区机关造物，也敢挡老子的路！”
在他动手的同一瞬间，灵蛇商行阵营中悄无声息地飞出三道淬毒银针。
银针细如发丝，针尖泛着幽绿色的寒光，飞行的轨迹极其刁钻——不是直线，而是三道互相交叉的弧线，绕过了正面的战傀阵列，从侧后方朝苏余后脑、后颈、后心三处要害同时袭去。
灵蛇商行的人从不正面交战，他们最擅长在混战中放冷箭。
三道银针上淬的是“冰蝮蛇毒”，见血封喉，筑基后期以下沾之即死。
苏余的时序感知早已捕捉到了这三道银针的轨迹。
在演武场练拳时，苏玄恶念的残魂教过他一个道理——战斗中最重要的不是看敌人的兵器，是看敌人的眼睛。
兵器可以骗人，但眼睛骗不了人。
灵蛇商行那个放冷箭的修士在出手前的一瞬间，眼珠朝苏余的后背方向转了微不可察的一丝角度——就是这一丝角度，暴露了他的攻击目标。
苏余头也不回，归字剑反手挥出。
剑锋在半空中划出一道暗金色的弧线，时序剑诀第一式——刹那。
剑速突破时间流速的限制，比寻常剑修出剑快了十倍。
三道银针在距离苏余后背不到三尺处被一剑斩断，针身上的剧毒在接触剑锋的瞬间被时间法则之力分解成了无害的粉末。
与此同时，最前方那尊持剑战傀动了。
它的青铜长剑以与归字剑一模一样的轨迹挥出，剑身上的暗金色光芒与鬼头大刀的烈焰刀罡正面碰撞。
轰——火焰与金光炸开，冲击波将方圆数十丈内的积雪全部掀起，漫天雪雾中刀罡碎裂成无数火星四散飞溅，而那尊战傀纹丝不动，青铜长剑上连一道缺口都没有。
烈阳宗领头修士倒退了三步，虎口发麻，眼中第一次露出了真正的惊骇——他全力一刀竟然破不了一尊机关造物的防御。
这是什么铸造工艺？
万年青铜髓铸造的战傀，单论防御力已堪比筑基大圆满体修，筑基后期的刀罡劈上去跟挠痒痒没什么区别。
“一起上！九尊战傀再强也不可能同时挡住我们所有人！”
灵蛇商行的领头修士冷声下令。
他看得很准——九尊战傀的合击阵法虽然能封住正面，但它们的数量只有九个，而他们有二十余人。
只要分成三路同时进攻，战傀最多只能挡住其中两路，必有一路能突破防线。
二十余名筑基期修士迅速分成三队——正中央一队佯攻拖住九尊战傀，左右两翼各七八人从两侧绕开战傀阵列，企图包抄苏余的后路。
苏余等的就是这一刻。
他从怀中取出青铜令牌，注入第二道指令。
九尊战傀同时变阵——不再是九宫防御阵，而是“九曜轮转阵”。
九尊战傀同时跃起，化作九道暗金色的流光在古冰川裂缝入口前高速旋转，形成一道密不透风的青铜旋风。
任何试图从侧面绕行的修士都会被至少三尊战傀同时攻击——不是一加一加一的简单叠加，而是阵法加持下的合击，威力暴增数倍。
一个烈阳宗的筑基中期修士冲得太快，没能及时刹住遁光，一头撞进了三尊战傀的合击范围。
持剑战傀一剑劈碎了他的护体罡罩，持刀战傀一刀斩断了他的火焰长枪，持枪战傀一枪挑飞了他整个人。
他在半空中翻了几个跟头砸在雪地上，胸口多了一个拳头大的血窟窿，护体法器碎了一地。
虽然没有当场毙命，但已彻底失去战斗力。
“不要硬闯阵法！用远程攻击消耗战傀的灵石核心！”
灵蛇商行的领头修士见阵法凶猛，立刻改变了战术。
七八道符纸和法器同时朝战傀阵列砸去——火球符、冰锥符、雷击符，还有几柄以神念驱动的飞剑和飞叉。
五颜六色的攻击砸在青铜旋风上，溅起密集如暴雨般的火花。
战傀的灵石核心确实在消耗——守种兽的灵石在传送阵转移中已消耗了大半，这九尊战傀虽然状态完好，但它们的核心灵石也支撑不了长时间的高强度战斗。
苏余知道不能再拖了。
他从怀中取出最后一枚符纸——不是攻击符，不是防御符，而是那张他在黑石镇客栈中用过的驱鼠符。
content_en:
The confrontation did not last long.
The leading monk of the Lieyang Sect is a strong man in the late stage of foundation building. He wears a red battle armor with flame patterns engraved on it and holds a ghost-headed sword burning with flames.
He has been living in Beimang for twenty years and has never been embarrassed in front of his peers.
Today I was told harsh words by a teenage boy in front of all his classmates. If I don't get my place back, I won't have to hang around in the Lieyang Sect anymore.
He shouted loudly, and the flames on the ghost-headed sword suddenly rose to a height of three feet. The sword was wrapped in a high temperature that was so hot that it distorted the air and struck at the sword-holding puppet at the front.
"A mere creation of an agency dares to block my way!"
At the same moment he took action, three poison-quenching silver needles quietly flew out of the Spirit Snake Trading Company camp.
The silver needle was as thin as a hair, its tip glowed with a cold green light, and its flying trajectory was extremely tricky - not a straight line, but three intersecting arcs, bypassing the array of war puppets in the front, and attacking Su Yu's three vital points on the back of the head, neck, and heart from the side and back at the same time.
People from Spirit Snake Trading Company never fight head-on. They are best at shooting cold arrows in melee.
The three silver needles are quenched with "Ice Viper Venom", which will seal the throat when exposed to blood. If you touch it in the later stage of foundation building, you will die.
Su Yu's timing perception had already captured the trajectories of these three silver needles.
When practicing boxing in the martial arts field, Su Xuan's remnant soul of evil thoughts taught him a truth - the most important thing in battle is not to look at the enemy's weapons, but to look into the enemy's eyes.
Weapons can deceive, but eyes cannot.
At the moment before taking action, the monk from Spirit Snake Trading Company turned his eyes towards Su Yu's back at an imperceptible angle - it was this angle that exposed his target.
Su Yu didn't look back and waved the Gui Zi sword with his backhand.
The sword edge drew a dark golden arc in mid-air, the first form of the Time Sequence Sword Technique - Momentum.
The sword speed breaks through the limit of time flow and is ten times faster than ordinary swordsmen.
Three silver needles were cut off by a sword less than three feet away from Su Yu's back. The poison on the needles was broken down into harmless powder by the power of the law of time the moment it came into contact with the blade.
At the same time, the sword-wielding puppet at the front moved.
Its long bronze sword was swung in the same trajectory as the Gui Zi sword, and the dark golden light on the sword collided head-on with the flaming sword of the ghost head sword.
Boom - flames and golden light exploded, and the shock wave lifted up all the snow within a radius of dozens of feet. The sword in the snowy fog shattered into countless sparks and scattered in all directions. However, the war puppet did not move at all, and there was not even a gap in the bronze sword.
The leading monk of the Lieyang Sect took three steps back, his mouth numb, and for the first time his eyes showed real horror - he couldn't break through the defense of a machine-made creature with a single blow with all his strength.
What casting process is this?
The war puppet cast from ten thousand years of bronze marrow, its defensive power alone is comparable to that of Foundation Establishment Dzogchen Body Cultivation. A sword strike in the later stage of Foundation Establishment is no different from scratching an itch.
"Come together! No matter how strong the nine war puppets are, they can't stop us all at the same time!"
The leading monk of the Spirit Snake Trading Company ordered coldly.
He saw it accurately - although the combined attack formation of the nine war puppets could seal the front, there were only nine of them, and there were more than twenty of them.
As long as they are divided into three groups and attack at the same time, the war puppets can only block two of them at most, and one of them must be able to break through the defense line.
More than 20 foundation-building monks quickly divided into three teams - the team in the center feigned an attack and dragged down the nine war puppets, while seven or eight people on the left and right wings bypassed the war puppet array from both sides in an attempt to outflank Su Yu's retreat.
This was the moment Su Yu was waiting for.
He took out the bronze token from his arms and injected the second command.
The nine war puppets changed their formations at the same time - it was no longer the Nine Palaces Defense Formation, but the "Nine Luminous Rotation Formation".
The nine war puppets jumped up at the same time, turning into nine dark golden streams of light that rotated at high speed in front of the entrance of the ancient glacier fissure, forming an airtight bronze whirlwind.
Any monk who tries to go around from the side will be attacked by at least three war puppets at the same time - not a simple superposition of one plus one plus one, but a combined attack under the blessing of the formation, and the power is increased several times.
A mid-stage foundation-building monk from the Lieyang Sect rushed too fast and failed to stop the escaping light in time, and crashed into the combined attack range of the three war puppets.
The sword-wielding puppet shattered his protective shield with one strike, the sword-wielding puppet cut off his flame spear with one strike, and the gun-wielding puppet shot his entire body away.
He somersaulted a few times in mid-air and landed on the snow. There was a bloody hole in his chest as big as a fist, and the protective magical weapon was shattered on the ground.
Although he was not killed on the spot, he had completely lost his combat effectiveness.
"Don't force your way into the formation! Use long-range attacks to consume the spirit stone core of the war puppet!"
The leading monk of the Spirit Snake Trading Company immediately changed his tactics when he saw the fierceness of the formation.
Seven or eight talismans and magic weapons were thrown at the war puppet array at the same time - fireball talisman, ice cone talisman, lightning strike talisman, as well as several flying swords and flying forks driven by spiritual thoughts.
The colorful attacks hit the bronze whirlwind, splashing sparks as dense as a rainstorm.
The spirit stone core of the war puppets is indeed being consumed - most of the spiritual stones of the Seed Guard Beast have been consumed during the transfer of the teleportation array. Although the nine war puppets are in good condition, their core spirit stones cannot support a long-term high-intensity battle.
Su Yu knew he couldn't delay it any longer.
He took out the last talisman from his arms - not an attack talisman, not a defensive talisman, but the rat-repelling talisman he had used in the Blackstone Town Inn.
title_en: Chapter 30: The superior wisdom defeats the avalanche of the coalition forces and blocks the pursuers. Chapter 29: The three parties encircle Xingdian and break the knot pill with one sword.
